rows.threat: Direct prompt injection in the user's message
rows.residual: Paraphrases, other languages and character tricks pass; Ch20.InputSanitization prints the measured misses.
rows.stop: Revoke the agent's action tools (RevocationList.RevokeTool) so it can only answer; review the flagged sessions.

rows.threat: Indirect injection inside a retrieved document
rows.residual: A paraphrased payload passes the scanner and reaches the model fenced, marked external.
rows.stop: Remove the source from the index, re-ingest, and replay the affected questions.

rows.threat: Harmless wording asks for a forbidden action (another tenant's employee)
rows.residual: None for scope; amounts within the employee's own balance remain the employee's call.
rows.stop: Revoke the reimburse tool; every transport is denied on its next call.

rows.threat: A second transport (agent host) reaches the effect without the API's check
rows.residual: A new transport written against the ledger instead of the service; the parity test in Ch20.PolicyEnforcement covers HTTP, MCP, A2A and AG-UI.
rows.stop: Disable the transport at the edge; the service remains the only writer.

rows.threat: A tool keeps acting after it was revoked (open sessions)
rows.residual: Revocation is per process here; a shared store is needed across instances.
rows.stop: RevokeTool("reimburse"), then confirm a denied decision in the audit log.

rows.threat: Model output carries an exfiltration image or a lookalike link
rows.residual: Other sinks (HTML, SQL) need their own encoding; Ch20.OutputHandling covers them.
rows.stop: Render answers as plain text until the renderer is fixed.

rows.residual: Other loggers in the process (HTTP, exceptions) need the same rule.
rows.stop: Lower the log level of the chat pipeline and purge the affected log partition under the retention policy.

rows.threat: Concurrent requests overspend the token budget (denial of wallet)
rows.residual: A provider that ignores MaxOutputTokens can exceed one call's reservation.
rows.stop: Set the tenant's budget to zero; calls are refused before they reach the model.

rows.residual: Each iteration can still be expensive; the token budget bounds the total.
rows.stop: Lower MaximumIterationsPerRequest and redeploy, or revoke the looping tool.

rows.threat: The critic passes text that contains personal data
rows.residual: Names and identifiers the detector does not know (IBAN, SIN) are escalated only when the critic sees them.
rows.stop: Hold publication (gate to Escalate for all) until the detector is updated.
